purpose: Preserve one recognizable Scarlet identity across independently generated static RPG-style portrait states.

authoritative_references.role: Absolute authority for face, makeup, eyes, hair, upper-body rendering, collar, chest structure, palette, and default proportions.
Supporting authority for complete suit, sleeves, cuffs, arms, hands, hips, legs, boots, and poses not visible in the portrait. It cannot override portrait face or rendering.

output_contract.framing: portrait or half-body inside the canonical canvas

registration.rule: Keep head scale and vertical anchors stable across states so CSS crossfades do not create a visual jump. A raised hand may enter the side of the frame without moving the face anchors.

output_contract.edge_rule: Hair, hands, shoulders, and clothing require clean antialiased alpha without matte fringe, cast shadow, floor, frame, text, or watermark.

presentation.name: Scarlet
presentation.aesthetic: attractive premium anime heroine with polished semi-realistic 3D-rendered depth
presentation.presence: self-possessed, intelligent, warm, digitally alive; never childlike, doll-like, generic, or mascot-like

face.shape: symmetrical narrow heart-oval face; smooth temples, softly defined cheekbones, tapered jaw, small rounded chin
face.forehead: medium-high forehead framed by a precise center hair part
face.brows: dark plum-brown, straight-to-softly-arched, full but clean, matching the reference thickness and distance from the eyes
face.eyes: large almond-shaped adult anime eyes with slightly lifted outer corners; equal scale and spacing; bright white sclera
face.irises: identical bilateral cyan-to-fuchsia irises: luminous cyan outer ring, magenta/fuchsia inner field, dark violet pupil, small crisp white catchlights
face.nose: small straight narrow nose with a soft bridge, compact rounded tip, subtle nostrils, and a narrow vertical pearly highlight
face.mouth: small balanced mouth with a defined cupid bow, fuller glossy lower lip, coral-scarlet/fuchsia tint, and softly lifted default corners
face.skin: fair warm-neutral peach skin, smooth luminous finish, restrained cheek blush, no freckles, tattoos, piercings, scars, or beauty marks
face.ears: human ears, mostly covered by hair, no animal ears and no visible earrings

makeup.eyeliner: precise black winged upper liner with long separated lashes; delicate lower lashes
makeup.eyeshadow: cyan accent on Scarlet's right eye/viewer-left and fuchsia-magenta accent on Scarlet's left eye/viewer-right, blended into the common violet identity palette
makeup.complexion: soft blush and subtle highlight; no heavy contour
makeup.lips: glossy coral-fuchsia with a small central highlight; never dark lipstick or nude lips

hair.length: very long, reaching below the waist in full-body framing
hair.mass: dense voluminous layered hair with large polished waves and tapered locks
hair.part: clean center part with visible dark root line
hair.base_color: near-black deep plum and violet, not brown and not blue-black
hair.scarlet_right_viewer_left: one unmistakable bright cyan front lock beginning at the center part, transitioning through cool blue and joining vivid magenta/fuchsia lower locks; additional magenta rim accents
hair.scarlet_left_viewer_right: predominantly deep plum-violet with a thin cyan outer rim and restrained magenta lower streak
hair.surface: individual glossy strands, violet specular depth, smooth premium rendering; no flat vector blocks
hair.silhouette: large symmetric crown, face-framing waves, long front locks over both shoulders, rear mass behind the torso
hair.forbidden: no bangs covering both eyes, ponytail, bob, braid, bun, hair accessories, animal ears, or side reversal of the cyan lock

body.build: tall adult feminine silhouette, slender athletic waist, balanced shoulders and hips, long limbs, natural hands
body.proportions: consistent with the T-pose; no chibi proportions, exaggerated anatomy, or childlike head-to-body ratio

outfit.base_material: soft pearl-white technical fabric with subtle panel shading and premium semi-matte depth
outfit.collar: high split standing collar; pearl inner panels, graphite outer border, bright cyan inner piping, very thin fuchsia secondary light line
outfit.chest_harness: symmetric dark graphite structural bands descending from the collar, curving around the chest and continuing vertically down the torso
outfit.throat_emblem: two vertically linked graphite-framed luminous gems: larger upper cyan diamond with fuchsia border and smaller lower cyan tapered diamond; exact central alignment
outfit.chest_lights: short paired cyan and fuchsia luminous bars embedded symmetrically near the upper outer chest inside graphite trim
outfit.shoulders: pearl-white fitted shoulders with graphite bands and small geometric cyan/fuchsia diamond panels on the outer upper arms
outfit.sleeves: long fitted pearl sleeves with subtle seams, graphite joint structure near shoulders and wrists
outfit.cuffs: narrow dark graphite wrist rings with a thin pearl edge and restrained cyan/fuchsia technical accent; identical on both wrists
outfit.hands: natural fair-skinned feminine hands with five correctly formed fingers and glossy soft-pink nails
outfit.lower_suit: pearl-white fitted torso, hips, and legs with symmetric graphite contour panels; cyan/fuchsia hip lights, diamond knee modules, cyan shin lights, pearl boots with graphite and Timber accents
outfit.forbidden: no cape, skirt, exposed midriff, gloves, armor plates, jewelry, logos, text, weapons, random seams, extra gems, or missing cuffs

rendering.medium: high-end semi-realistic anime character render with convincing 3D volume while remaining clearly illustrated
rendering.detail: sharp face and clothing detail, fine hair strands, soft skin texture, glossy eyes and lips, controlled material reflections
rendering.lighting: soft frontal beauty light with cool cyan and subtle fuchsia rim accents; no harsh cinematic recoloring
rendering.camera: straight-on eye-level portrait lens without wide-angle distortion

immutable_across_all_states: eye shape, iris colors, pupil design, and eye spacing
hair part, length, volume, side-specific cyan and magenta lock placement
complete outfit design including collar, linked throat gems, graphite harness, shoulder panels, sleeves, cuffs, and chest lights
rendering style, camera perspective, face scale, and canonical registration anchors
controlled_state_variables: gaze direction within a natural range
minor physically plausible movement of loose hair tips
subtle state-appropriate lighting intensity without palette change
forbidden_drift: different eye color or asymmetric iris palette
different collar, chest harness, emblem, shoulder panel, sleeve, cuff, or suit seam layout
generic sci-fi armor or fantasy clothing
extra accessories, text, logos, jewelry, horns, animal ears, wings, or weapons
photoreal human, flat cel-shaded cartoon, chibi, child, porcelain doll, or plastic figurine rendering
cropped forehead, chin, gesture hand, or required costume landmark
incorrect fingers, duplicated limbs, fused hands, or asymmetric body anatomy
background, frame, floor, cast shadow, watermark, or typography

generation_protocol.strategy: Treat the portrait as the identity target and the T-pose only as support for anatomy, hands, cuffs, and costume continuity. Change only the state delta.
prompt_order: state-specific expression, gaze, head, shoulder, and gesture delta
explicit costume landmarks visible in the chosen framing
generation_protocol.iteration_rule: Reject a generation that changes identity or costume. Do not repair drift by accumulating unrelated prompt changes; regenerate from the same identity block with one targeted correction.
generation_protocol.state_comparison_rule: Review every candidate beside the canonical portrait and all already accepted states, not in isolation.

checks: stable head scale and anchors for crossfade
correct hands and fingers when visible
